summary:
Iter93 — Bug 16 stale-closure fix REGRESSION VERIFIED but the fix INTRODUCES A NEW CRITICAL RUNTIME CRASH. VoiceInputButton renders an ErrorBoundary fallback ('Something went wrong … Cannot access stopAndTranscribe before initialization') on EVERY screen that mounts it: /table/[id], /dm/[id], /group/[id], /recipes/[id]. Root cause: TDZ (Temporal Dead Zone) violation on line 252 — handleMicPress's useCallback deps array [state, beginCapture, stopAndTranscribe] is evaluated during render BEFORE `const stopAndTranscribe = useCallback(...)` is declared on line 265. Since `const` is not hoisted with its initializer, reading it before its declaration throws ReferenceError. Confirmed live in browser preview by navigating to /table/fp-cafe-permanent — the error boundary caught it immediately (message reads literally 'Cannot access stopAndTranscribe before initialization'). Node repro of the same pattern also reproduces the TDZ error in 1 line.

All seven of the stale-closure fix STATIC assertions independently PASS (elapsedRef/startedAtRef declared, beginCapture writes both, setState('transcribing') FIRST, elapsedRef.current for duration, no `elapsed` in stopAndTranscribe deps, `stopAndTranscribe` added to handleMicPress deps, seven __DEV__ diagnostic branches, setAudioModeAsync release with catch(e) console.warn). BUT the correction of the deps-array to include stopAndTranscribe is what wired the TDZ — the declaration order was not updated.

Backend contract UNCHANGED: 3/3 pytest passed on /api/mcgs/george/transcribe (401 without bearer, 400/422 without file, 200 {text:string} with valid wav + bearer). useGeorgeVoiceInput.ts is byte-for-byte unchanged (verified). Metro bundles cleanly (1629 modules, no build errors). Fix A/B/C from iter92 are structurally still in place in profile.tsx / dm/[id].tsx / table/[id].tsx / recipes/[id].tsx — but iter92's Fix C (making dm/table/recipes use the shared VoiceInputButton) is now EFFECTIVELY BROKEN in production behaviour because those three screens all crash on mount.

FIX (one-line move): swap the declaration order so `stopAndTranscribe` is defined BEFORE `handleMicPress`. That preserves every intent of the applied fix and removes the TDZ. Recommend the main agent apply this — I have deliberately NOT edited VoiceInputButton.tsx per Garry's strict scope instruction (this is inside the stale-closure fix, not scope creep, but the deliberate scope hold makes me route it through the main agent).

ui_bugs.issue: Renders ErrorBoundary on every mount: 'ReferenceError: Cannot access stopAndTranscribe before initialization'. useCallback deps on line 252 read `stopAndTranscribe` before its `const` declaration on line 265 (TDZ). Verified live at /table/fp-cafe-permanent — screen shows the ErrorBoundary card, not the chat composer. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceInputButton.tsx:252 and :265.
ui_bugs.testID: table-voice / dm-mic / recipe-comment-voice / (group VoiceInputButton) — none rendered because component crashes before children mount

integration_issues.issue: Because the composer crashes, the member never gets to tap the mic — this is a strict superset of Bug 16's original symptom (silent-fail became hard-fail via ErrorBoundary). The stale-closure fix logic itself looks correct, but is unreachable behind the TDZ.

action_items: URGENT — fix the TDZ in /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceInputButton.tsx by moving the `stopAndTranscribe = useCallback(…)` declaration (currently lines 265–425) ABOVE the `handleMicPress = useCallback(…)` declaration (currently lines 232–252). Keep `stopAndTranscribe`'s deps unchanged. Keep `handleMicPress`'s deps `[state, beginCapture, stopAndTranscribe]` unchanged. Nothing else needs to change. After the swap: re-load /table/fp-cafe-permanent (or any DM/table/group/recipes screen) — the composer should mount without hitting the ErrorBoundary.
After the swap, re-run the seven STATIC assertions from Garry's spec — they should all still hold.
Physical-device mic testing remains user-only on the next TestFlight build (unchanged from iter89-92).
critical_code_review_comments: Deps array of a useCallback is evaluated eagerly at each render — you cannot forward-reference a later `const` from it. This is exactly what the previous eslint-disable was hiding on line 252 in the prior build; removing the disable comment is the right call, but declaration order also has to be fixed to satisfy it.

The `stopAndTranscribe` reference on line 221 (inside `beginCapture`'s auto-stop setTimeout callback) is fine — it's called at timer-fire time, well after both consts have initialised. Only the deps array on line 252 is the problem.

Once declaration order is swapped, `beginCapture` will need to be declared even earlier (or move it too), because `stopAndTranscribe` references nothing from `beginCapture` but `beginCapture` schedules `stopAndTranscribe` — order that works: setState/refs → clearTimers → stopAndTranscribe (const) → beginCapture (const) → handleMicPress (const) → acceptRationaleAndRequest (const). Alternative: keep `beginCapture` before `stopAndTranscribe`, but then remove `stopAndTranscribe` from `handleMicPress`'s deps OR gate the reference via a ref (mutable box) — but the simple declaration-order swap is safest and preserves the applied intent exactly.

Everything else about the diagnostic instrumentation is genuinely solid — every early-return path has both a __DEV__ warn and a member-facing onError message; the elapsedRef+startedAtRef pattern (with tick reading Date.now() - startedAtRef.current) is monotonic and immune to state closure, and setState('transcribing') genuinely fires before clearTimers/recorder.stop. Once the TDZ is fixed, this should resolve Garry's symptom cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 0% for any screen mounting VoiceInputButton (table/dm/group/recipes) — ErrorBoundary. 100% for screens that don't (home renders fine).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter93 introduced a TDZ crash in VoiceInputButton.tsx: `stopAndTranscribe` referenced in handleMicPress's useCallback deps array (line 252) BEFORE the `const stopAndTranscribe = useCallback(...)` declaration (line 265). This crashes /table/[id], /dm/[id], /group/[id], /recipes/[id] with 'Cannot access stopAndTranscribe before initialization'. Main agent must swap the declaration order (define stopAndTranscribe before handleMicPress). After that, all 7 static assertions of Garry's stale-closure fix are already in place and correct; backend transcribe contract is intact. Re-open /table/fp-cafe-permanent after the swap to confirm the composer renders. Physical-device mic still user-only.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: ES6 `const` declarations are hoisted but stay in the Temporal Dead Zone until their initializer runs. Reading a `const` before its declaration throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access '<name>' before initialization`. In VoiceInputButton.tsx, `handleMicPress` is declared at line 232 with useCallback deps `[state, beginCapture, stopAndTranscribe]`; the deps array is evaluated when useCallback is CALLED (at render time, top-to-bottom), and at that point the sibling `const stopAndTranscribe = useCallback(...)` at line 265 has not yet been initialised. Repro (in-container Node): `function C() { const a = () => b(); const _ = [a, b]; const b = () => {}; } C();` → same TDZ error. Fix: move `stopAndTranscribe` declaration above `handleMicPress` (or above and use the ordering: refs/timers → stopAndTranscribe → beginCapture → handleMicPress → acceptRationaleAndRequest). No other code change is required.
